answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. The relic of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A comet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dawn of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
